title: Tim McGraw, Sam Barber, Riley Green to headline 2027 Cavendish Beach Music Festival
line: Tim McGraw, Sam Barber and Riley Green will headline the 2027 Cavendish Beach Music Festival. Pack sunscreen and boots.

title: Tucker Wetmore Has Two Country Stars as His Lake Neighbors
line: Tucker Wetmore moved in near lake neighbors Dustin Lynch and Gary Allan, and things got a lot more fun. Hope the dock holds up.

title: Lady A to Host and Perform at ‘CMA Country Christmas’ 2026 Alongside Trisha Yearwood, Zach Top and More
line: Lady A will host and perform at 'CMA Country Christmas' on Tuesday, Dec. 1, alongside Trisha Yearwood and Zach Top. Santa's getting a steel guitar.

title: Country music legend Garth Brooks announces 10 Irish shows for 2027
line: Garth Brooks has announced 10 shows in Ireland for 2027. Ireland is about to get friends in low places.

title: “People Are So Easy To Walk Away” — Tim McGraw Opens Up On Success Of 30-Year Marriage To Faith Hill
line: Tim McGraw, inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame on Oct. 18, talked about his 30-year marriage to Faith Hill, saying 'people are so easy to walk away.' That's a song worth singing.

title: What We Know About Randy Travis’ New Album, ‘Same Old Way’ (No, It’s Not AI)
line: Randy Travis' new album, 'Same Old Way,' comes out Nov. 13, and no, it's not AI. Some things stay real.

title: Stephen Wilson Jr. Reveals He Has No Memory of His ‘Stand By Me’ CMA Awards Performance
line: Stephen Wilson Jr. says he has no memory of his 'Stand By Me' CMA Awards performance and has never watched it. Hope somebody taped it.

title: Mickey Guyton to embark on "Mickey Guyton & Friends Holiday Tour"
line: Mickey Guyton is heading out on the 'Mickey Guyton & Friends Holiday Tour.' Jingle bells with a twang.

title: Ella Langley, Kacey Musgraves + More On 'Hunger Games' Soundtrack
line: Ella Langley and Kacey Musgraves are on the soundtrack to the new Hunger Games movie. May the odds be ever in country's favor.

title: Riley Green Strips It Down With Acoustic Performances From ‘That’s Just Me’
line: Riley Green released acoustic performances from his new 19-song album That's Just Me. Stripped-down still sounds good.

title: WATCH: Riley Green Calls Allie Rae a ‘Little Mini Reba’ After Her Lainey Wilson Cover on ‘The Voice’
line: Riley Green called contestant Allie Rae a "little mini Reba" after her Lainey Wilson cover on The Voice. Reba just got a tiny sidekick.

title: Blake Shelton's Unusual Way of Getting His Friends to His Ranch
line: Blake Shelton skips the seven-mile drive from the airport to his Oklahoma ranch and sends a helicopter to pick up his guests. Nothing says welcome like rotor blades.

title: Morgan Wallen Curates His Own 24/7 SiriusXM Channel, Morgan Wallen Radio
line: Morgan Wallen now has his own 24/7 SiriusXM channel, called Morgan Wallen Radio, which he curates himself. The request line must be easy.

title: Shaboozey Reveals How Dolly Parton Helped Shape His Country Music Roots Through His Nigerian Father
line: Shaboozey says Dolly Parton helped shape his country roots through his Nigerian father. Dolly really does get around.

title: Tyler Hubbard to headline K92.3’s Jingle Jam at Apopka Amphitheater
line: Tyler Hubbard will headline K92.3's Jingle Jam at the Apopka Amphitheater in Florida. Sleigh bells meet steel guitars.

title: Country star Garth Brooks adds a 3rd Hamilton show to his Canadian tour
line: Garth Brooks added a third Hamilton show to his Canadian tour. Canada can't get enough of those friends in low places.

title: WATCH: Joe Henley Earns Standing Ovation From All Coaches With Keith Whitley Cover on ‘The Voice’
line: Joe Henley earned a standing ovation from all the coaches on The Voice with a Keith Whitley cover. High praise from a tough room.

title: Maren Morris Wants to Start a Film Club For Iconic Movies She’s Never Seen After Finally Watching This Absolute Holiday Classic
line: Maren Morris finally watched Home Alone after 28 years and wants to start a film club for iconic movies she's never seen. Kevin would approve.

title: Craig Morgan Salutes Toby Keith, American Soldiers and the Music That Made Him on New Album 'My Country'
line: Craig Morgan salutes Toby Keith, American soldiers and the music that made him on his new album My Country. Flags and guitars, a good mix.

title: Quick-Thinking Dog Saves A Minnesota Homeowner From A Surprise Black Bear Encounter
line: Zeus the dog protected Minnesota homeowner Bailey Jacobson from a surprise black bear in her driveway. That's one very good boy.

title: Carly Pearce, Jennifer Nettles and Carter Faith featured on soundtrack to Netflix's upcoming 'Heartland'
line: Carly Pearce, Jennifer Nettles and Carter Faith are on the soundtrack to Netflix's upcoming Heartland. Country is headed to streaming.

title: Ty Myers, the country singer/songwriter, announced as 1st headliner for Musikfest 2027 in Bethlehem, Pa.
line: Ty Myers is the first headliner announced for Musikfest 2027 in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. Early bird gets the stage.

title: Country music legend Shania Twain to kick off major 2027 UK tour in North Yorkshire
line: Shania Twain will kick off her 2027 UK tour in North Yorkshire. She's bringing the man, and the feelings, overseas.

title: Video of two brothers Irish step dancing to Beyoncé's country hit 'Texas Hold 'Em' is pure delight
line: Two brothers Irish step danced to Beyonce's country hit "Texas Hold 'Em" in a video that's pure delight. Country with a jig.

title: “It’s A Very Special Song To Both Of Us” — Miranda Lambert Calls Writing “Over You” With Ex-Husband Blake Shelton Magical
line: Miranda Lambert says writing "Over You" with ex-husband Blake Shelton was magical, calling it a very special song to both of them. Some songs outlast everything.

title: Riley Green Shares His Dream of Becoming a Grand Ole Opry Member
line: Riley Green says his big dream is still to become a Grand Ole Opry member. The Opry should keep a seat warm.

title: Hear HARDY and Blake Shelton’s Carefree New Duet ‘Hell’
line: HARDY and Blake Shelton released a carefree new duet called "Hell." Hot new duet, no pun intended.

title: Zach Bryan’s New Song Is a Cover By an Obscure Kentucky Songwriter
line: Zach Bryan covered "Kentucky Hurricane" by Kentucky songwriter Ian Noe and uploaded the video to YouTube. Nice way to share the spotlight.

title: Ashley Cooke to release first-ever Christmas EP ‘WRAPPED’
line: Ashley Cooke is releasing her first-ever Christmas EP, called WRAPPED. Early gift for country fans.

title: Parker McCollum On Teaching His Son Manners And Respect
line: Parker McCollum says he's raising his son to be respectful above all else, even if brains don't run in the family. Manners first, math later.
